subtitle: Ask the Operator or browse categories. Orange Final check before Operator acts. WhatsApp drafts are copy-only (not auto-sent).

lessons.title: Office Operator (phase 1)
lessons.summary: Ask box can run live tools: pending Direct Payment mandates, and parent portal PIN after Confirm. It does not write covers or invoices alone.
lessons.where: Office help → Ask Office help / Operator (top of this page)

demos.caption: Ops Hub → Office help (gold ring) opens this guide.
Type at the top of Office help — Operator tools run when the question matches.
PIN stays hidden until the orange Final check — then Confirm — Operator proceed.

steps: Stay signed in on the admin portal (same browser), then open Office help.
Ask: Who has not authorised Direct Payment? — live list + phone script.
Ask: PIN for [child or parent name] — pick the family, orange Final check, then Confirm. Copy the WhatsApp draft and paste to the parent.
Operator never sends WhatsApp automatically — only prepares the message for you to copy.
How-to questions still open guide lessons (Schedule & Covers, Overview, etc.).
tips: Phase 1: list pending mandates + reveal PIN with orange Final check + copy-ready WhatsApp draft. Schedule writes, day offs and mark paid stay manual.
After each new portal flow ships, update this guide so Ask and Operator stay the same truth.

lessons.title: Sessions Overview (day look-here)
lessons.summary: Overview is the only day board to trust. Standing seats repeat; exceptions come from Schedule & Covers and day offs.

demos.caption: From Operations Hub open Sessions overview.
Day board: booked seats, open seats, COVER NEEDED chrome.

steps: Open Sessions Overview and pick the day you care about.
Check booked kids, open seats, covers and day-off chrome on that date only. Each booked card shows that child's photo on the right.
If something looks wrong, fix it in Schedule & Covers or Validate / HR day off — do not edit LOCAL for day-of checks.
After a change, wait for the board to refresh (or use the in-page refresh if shown).
tips: When a child moves to another instructor the same day, the old card is red and says Now plus the new instructor. The instructor who has the child shows a chip with the old instructor's Shift. This is admin Sessions Overview only. The worker portal keeps its own chips and alerts.
An empty seat and a Hold Waitlist do not need a cover. They do not appear on a worker card. A real child on that day still needs a cover when their instructor is off.
Parents do not see instructor day offs or COVER NEEDED — that is office/staff only.
Aquatic halves may merge on Staff Today; Overview / Schedule keep 30-minute cards when needed.
The page itself stays quiet. The i next to Sessions Overview holds what the board is. Live row counts stay off the page.

es.title: Sessions Overview (el tablero del dia)
es.summary: Overview es el unico tablero del dia en el que mirar. Las plazas fijas se repiten. Las excepciones vienen de Schedule & Covers y de los dias libres.
steps: Abre Sessions Overview y elige el dia.
Mira ninos reservados, plazas libres, covers y el dia libre, solo en esa fecha. Cada tarjeta con nino lleva su foto a la derecha.
Si algo esta mal, arreglalo en Schedule & Covers o en Validate / HR day off. No edites LOCAL para mirar el dia.
Despues de un cambio, espera a que el tablero se refresque.
tips: Cuando un nino pasa a otro instructor el mismo dia, la tarjeta vieja va en rojo y dice Now mas el instructor nuevo. El instructor que tiene al nino ve un chip con el Shift del instructor anterior. Esto es solo el Sessions Overview de admin. El portal del trabajador tiene sus propios chips y avisos.
Una plaza vacia y un Hold Waitlist no necesitan cover. No salen en la tarjeta del trabajador. Un nino de verdad ese dia si necesita cover cuando su instructor esta libre.
Los padres no ven dias libres del instructor ni COVER NEEDED. Eso es solo oficina y staff.
Las medias de aquatic pueden juntarse en Staff Today. Overview y Schedule mantienen tarjetas de 30 minutos cuando hace falta.
La pagina se queda limpia. La i al lado de Sessions Overview explica el tablero. Los contadores vivos no van en la pagina.

lessons.title: Schedule & Covers (one day)
lessons.summary: One-day exceptions: cancel a slot, assign cover, client absence, replace for that date only.

demos.caption: Pick date + band, then a one-day action (cover ring). Rest-of-term = Edit term slot.

steps: Open Schedule & Covers and select the date and session band.
Choose the action for that day only (cancel, cover, absence, reassign).
Save — Overview, Staff Today and parent chips update from schedule_overrides.
If the change should last for the rest of term, stop and use Edit term slot instead.
tips: Do not use Schedule & Covers to swap a client for every Monday of the term — that is Edit term slot.
Orange / red banners warn when a one-day action fights the standing roster.
A new shadowing or training shift is + Add session card, Type Shadowing or Training — see that lesson.

Move to another slot today is the one-day move, including into a seat that already has an admin absence. On Overview the original instructor still shows that child, with the chip Move in and change instructor, not No participant. The other instructor shows the absent child and, under that same time, the Moved in card. Edit term slot changes the standing weekday for the rest of term.

Swap with another child today exchanges every seat those two children have on that date only. Instructors stay on their times. Overview shows Swapped. Undo on either row removes the whole swap. The rest of term does not change.
A makeup on an open seat still shows that child when the instructor is off that day. The row name is the child, not No participant.
If a child is absent and someone moves into that seat the same day, the row shows the absent child, then Free, then the move-in. No participant is a standing empty seat.
From Sun 27 Sep, Gabriel and Cyrus swap the 11.00 and 11.45 halves. A cover saved on that seat follows the child who is in it now. It does not stay as COVER NEEDED on the new name.

es.title: Schedule & Covers (un dia)
es.summary: Excepciones de un dia: cancelar una franja, poner cover, falta del cliente, o sustituir solo esa fecha.
steps: Abre Schedule & Covers y elige la fecha y la franja.
Elige la accion solo de ese dia (cancelar, cover, falta, reasignar).
Guarda. Overview, Staff Today y los chips del padre se actualizan desde schedule_overrides.
Si el cambio tiene que durar el resto del term, para y usa Edit term slot.
tips: No uses Schedule & Covers para cambiar un cliente todos los lunes del term. Eso es Edit term slot.
Los avisos naranja o rojo saltan cuando una accion de un dia choca con el roster fijo.
Un turno nuevo de shadowing o training es + Add session card, Type Shadowing o Training.

Move to another slot today es el cambio de un dia, tambien a una plaza que ya tiene una falta de admin. En Overview el instructor original sigue viendo a ese nino, con el chip Move in and change instructor, no No participant. El otro instructor ve al nino ausente y, en la misma hora, la tarjeta Moved in. Edit term slot cambia el dia fijo el resto del term.

Swap with another child today cruza todas las plazas de esos dos ninos solo ese dia. Los instructores se quedan en su hora. Overview pone Swapped. Undo en cualquiera de las dos filas quita el cruce entero. El resto del term no cambia.
Un makeup en una plaza libre sigue ensenando a ese nino cuando el instructor esta libre ese dia. El nombre de la fila es el nino, no No participant.
Si un nino falta y alguien entra en esa plaza el mismo dia, la fila ensena al nino ausente, luego Free, luego el que entra. No participant es una plaza fija vacia.
Desde el domingo 27 Sep, Gabriel y Cyrus cambian las medias de las 11.00 y las 11.45. Un cover guardado en esa plaza sigue al nino que esta ahora. No se queda como COVER NEEDED en el nombre nuevo.

lessons.title: Add a shadowing or training shift
lessons.summary: Give someone shadowing or training hours for one day without taking over the instructor already on the client.
lessons.where: Operator → Schedule & Covers → + Add session card
steps: Open Schedule & Covers and expand + Add session card (new hours / instructor / participant).
Staff: type the first letters of the name. The list is everyone active on staff profiles, including people not yet on the standing board.
Type: Shadowing or Training. That type is what marks the shift.
Set Date, Start, End and Venue for that one shift.

Shadowing: pick Shadowing and choose the person they follow (for example Berta). Their booked participants for those hours appear under the field. Training still uses Who gives it as optional text. Where: Room, Pool or Both.
Press Add session. One card per shift. Repeat the form for each extra day.
To remove one: stay on that date, open + Add session card, and in Added cards (this date) press Remove on that row. Confirm. It leaves the staff app.
tips: This adds a new row. It does not replace the instructor already on the client.
Staff Today shows a Shadowing or Training card. The shadower does not submit session feedback. The child stays on Session feedback for the instructor already on that seat.
Timesheet pays these hours at £13.50/h.
Type Session is a client seat, not the shadowing rate. Use Shadowing when they are learning the shift.

Sessions Overview keeps the chip on the trainer's client row and also gives the shadower their own column, with one card per participant of the person they shadow, at that child's own time. People in a training or meeting show on the host column as participant cards. On Staff Today the card stays even on a day off. Area shows Online with an icon. The chip is one line: host name, then the group in brackets. Families are not messaged. The shadower does not submit feedback. The child still shows as awaiting feedback for the instructor on the seat.

lessons.title: Add extra hours on one day (session card)
lessons.summary: Put another worker on a client for part of the day without replacing the person already on that seat.
lessons.where: Operator → Schedule & Covers → + Add session card
steps: Open Schedule & Covers. Set the board date, and set the same date inside the form. The form can default to today.
Open the line + Add session card. It sits above the table and starts closed.
Type: Session. Pick Staff, Participant, Service, Start, End and Venue.
Press Add card. One card per slice of hours. Repeat for each extra person or time band.
Check Sessions Overview for that date. The card shows even when that person does not normally work the day. It also shows on their Staff Today, and they get a schedule alert.
tips: Change Instructor replaces the person on that row. Use Add session card when someone already on the board picks up extra hours, or when one seat must split between two people.
Do not Change Instructor over a worker who is off. That overwrites their seat.
On the row, Add a new card (keep this seat) copies time, client and venue into the form. You still choose the staff.

lessons.title: Undo a one-day change
lessons.summary: Undo change removes a saved override on that row. A pink COVER NEEDED from a day off is not an override.
lessons.where: Operator → Schedule & Covers → Change on a row
steps: Open the date and click Change on the row.
If the drawer says Current override and shows Undo change, that button removes only that saved one-day change.
If it says Current override: None, there is nothing to undo. Close the drawer.
A pink COVER NEEDED from Validate day / HR day off is the day off. Do not save Absent, Cancelled or Change Instructor on that seat just to clear the pink.
To drop a card you added with Add session card, use Remove on Added cards for that date.
tips: To drop one standing row for a single day (for example Office that should not run that Monday), Change → Cancelled → Save override. That is one day, not the rest of term.
Office is not a child. Ignore an absents / parent-notify toast if you cancel an Office row.

es.title: Deshacer un cambio de un dia
es.summary: Undo change quita un override guardado en esa fila. Un COVER NEEDED rosa de un dia libre no es un override.
es.where: Today → Schedule & Covers → Change en una fila
steps: Abre la fecha y pulsa Change en la fila.
Si el cajon dice Current override y ensena Undo change, ese boton quita solo ese cambio de un dia.
Si dice Current override: None, no hay nada que deshacer. Cierra el cajon.
Un COVER NEEDED rosa de Validate day / HR day off es el dia libre. No guardes Absent, Cancelled ni Change Instructor en esa plaza solo para quitar el rosa.
Para quitar una tarjeta que anadiste con Add session card, usa Remove en Added cards de esa fecha.
tips: Para quitar una fila fija un solo dia (por ejemplo Office que no debe salir ese lunes), Change → Cancelled → Save override. Es un dia, no el resto del term.
Office no es un nino. Ignora un aviso de absents / parent-notify si cancelas una fila Office.

lessons.title: Day Centre: one instructor cancelled, client still on
lessons.summary: Cancelling one Day Centre instructor does not cancel the client while another instructor still has them that day.
steps: Cancel only the instructor cell that is not happening: Change on that row → Cancelled → Save override.
Leave the other instructors' rows. The client stays while at least one instructor still has them that day.
The client is cancelled for that day only when every instructor cell for that client that day is cancelled.
One feedback for that client that day covers the whole Day Centre team, including people on a new session card.
An Absent mark on Schedule & Covers means that feedback is already done. Do not chase it as missing.
A Cancelled mark on one instructor's timed row does not block the others from sending that shared feedback. The app can still ask them.
tips: When one of two Day Centre instructors is off, both stay on the same line: the one who is in, then the one who is off, then COVER NEEDED. Do not remove either name from the roster.

To fill that gap without touching the day-off instructor, press Add card for the same child. Hours can be shorter and the worker can be someone else. Leave COVER NEEDED if nobody matches the full time. Parents of Day Centre do not get a change message.
Day Centre instructors can move between participants. Those one-day changes update Team. They do not WhatsApp the parents.
After-school and weekend seats are fixed to an instructor, so a real cover there is what parents can see on Team.

lessons.title: Attach an opening or closing video
lessons.summary: Staff file the venue review. Admin can attach the walkthrough video after that day has finished.
steps: Staff open Venue on their app, choose the venue and the time, then photos and video. Venue and time are not filled in for them.
In admin, open Venue review and filter to the date.
Opening and closing of the same day stay as two rows. Attach the video on the matching row.
Use Upload video on that row. Max 50 MB. The day must have finished. A day that is still open should not have a closing video yet.
If there was no walkthrough, the note belongs on the row it describes (opening or closing), not on the other one.
tips: SwimFarm uses the same opening and closing rows as the other venues.

lessons.title: Validate day / add day off
lessons.summary: Mark a worker off for a day. Booked slots get COVER NEEDED so the office can fill them.
lessons.where: Day operations / H&R Add day off / Validate day
steps: Choose the staff member and the date they are off.
Confirm — the system writes staff_unavailability and COVER NEEDED for every booked service that day, at every venue.
The message says COVER NEEDED is on Schedule & Covers and Sessions Overview. Parents stay as they are until you assign the new instructor.
Check Sessions Overview for that date: day-off chrome and cover gaps should show.
Assign a real cover later in Schedule & Covers when you have someone. Parents see the new instructor only after that assign.
tips: A planned absence is the whole day, not only the venue written on the disruption report.
Afternoon only keeps the morning (before 3pm, including Day Centre) and shows Day off Afternoon under it. Northolt or Acton from 4.30 must not stay on that day.
Dashboard teleport must show the same day as the worker's own app, including that day off.
If the class was given to a cover and the child is Absent, the cover sees the name with Absent. The empty NO PARTICIPANT seat does not replace that name.
Parents never see instructor day offs or COVER NEEDED.
Prefer DB day offs over hardcoding in LOCAL / canonical.

lessons.title: Pending actions and Alerts
lessons.summary: Ops Hub strip: late forms, absents to decide, and the alerts inbox.

demos.caption: Top strip on Ops Hub — Alerts inbox and Pending queue.

steps: From Operations Hub, tap Alerts for incidents, cancellations, expenses and wellbeing.
Tap Pending for late feedback forms and absents / credits waiting for a decision.
Work the queue: approve / reject late forms; decide absents (none, credit, close).
Return to Overview if the decision should change the day board.
tips: Keep outstanding-feedback and alert lanes live unless Victor pauses them.

lessons.title: Office calendar (notes & meetings)
lessons.summary: Shared office notes on dates — tap the month glance on Ops Hub to open the full calendar.
lessons.where: Operations Hub → Calendar / Notes → Office calendar
steps: Tap the Calendar card on Operations Hub (month glance).
Add or edit a note / meeting on a date.
Mark items Done when finished so open counts drop.
Anyone with portal admin access sees the same calendar.
tips: On the hub calendar, a day with an open note is orange. A day whose notes are all Done is grey. Days with nothing stay white.

es.title: Calendario de oficina (notas y reuniones)
es.summary: Notas compartidas de la oficina por fecha. La tarjeta del mes en Operations Hub abre el calendario entero.
steps: Pulsa la tarjeta Calendar en Operations Hub (el mes pequeno).
Anade o edita una nota o una reunion en una fecha.
Marca Done cuando este hecha, para que baje el numero de abiertas.
Quien tiene acceso de admin ve el mismo calendario.
El numero de la tarjeta es cuantas notas siguen abiertas este mes, no cuantas reuniones hay en el ano.
tips: Las notas del calendario no cambian plazas ni covers. Un cambio de dia se hace en Schedule & Covers.
En el calendario del hub, un dia con nota abierta sale naranja. Si todas estan en Done, el dia sale gris. Sin nada, blanco.

lessons.title: Operations Hub: the buttons you use
lessons.summary: One screen shows the used buttons in each category, and the calendar stays on the side. WhatsApp, P, S, C and A stay in the top bar.
steps: Open Operations Hub. The title, the info circle and Office help sit together.

Every category is on the same screen. Sessions: Sessions overview, Schedule and Covers, Register. Services and places: Service roster, Places, Leads, Registered, Waiting list, Edit term slot. Clients and families: Active, Achievement photos, Parent consents. Finance: Re-enrolments and Bookings, Payments, Absents, credits and refunds, Cancelled services. H&R: Workers, Instructor timetable, Session disruptions, Late feedback, Documents, Finance. Potential workers: Interviews, Onboarding.
The calendar sits on the right. A day with an open note is orange. Press the calendar to open Office calendar.
The full menu is still in the sidebar. The hub only keeps the buttons used every day.
WhatsApp, Parents API, Staff API, C (Comms) and A (Announcements) stay in the top bar.
When that lane has unread messages, the button lights up and shows the number.
tips: Cancelled services is a place removed for the rest of term. A one-day absence stays in Absents, credits and refunds.
On a phone the calendar sits above the buttons and the page scrolls.
On every admin page the title, the info circle and Back or Help sit in one row.

es.title: Operations Hub: los botones que usas
es.summary: Una pantalla muestra los botones usados de cada categoria, y el calendario se queda al lado. WhatsApp, P, S, C y A siguen en la barra.
steps: Abre Operations Hub. El titulo, el circulo de info y Office help van juntos.
Todas las categorias estan en la misma pantalla: Sessions, Services and places, Clients and families, Finance, H&R y Potential workers. Son los botones que se usan cada dia.
El calendario esta a la derecha. Un dia con nota abierta sale naranja. Pulsa el calendario para abrir Office calendar.
El menu completo sigue en la barra lateral. El hub solo deja los botones de cada dia.
WhatsApp, Parents API, Staff API, C y A siguen en la barra de arriba.
tips: Cancelled services es una plaza quitada el resto del term. Una falta de un dia sigue en Absents, credits and refunds.
En el telefono el calendario va encima y la pagina baja.

categories.title: Services & places
categories.blurb: Places, leads, waiting list, registered, and standing seats.

lessons.title: Places, Leads, WAITING LIST and REGISTERED are different
lessons.summary: One menu, two jobs. The seat is Places and the roster. The person who is not a CLIENT yet is Leads, REGISTERED or WAITING LIST.
steps: Places (Booking Portal) is the offer: open seats and taken seats. Service roster is who is already booked and the standing instructor. New client puts a person into an open seat. Edit term slot changes that seat for the rest of term.
Leads is a parent who asked for an OTP code. Read Outcome: only looked, started registration, registered, already a client, or waiting list.
REGISTERED finished the registration form and has never had a place. Service and time stay empty. Pay hold, Hold and Lost slot are chips on that list.
WAITING LIST is someone who registered and the service they want is full. They are waiting for a place. They are not Leads and they are not REGISTERED.
A person with a place now is CLIENT. That list is Clients and Families, Active. They are not in these three lists.
tips: The path is Leads, then REGISTERED, then WAITING LIST if the service is full, then New client from an open seat on Places. After that they are on the Service roster as CLIENT.

es.title: Places, Leads, WAITING LIST y REGISTERED son cosas distintas
es.summary: Un menu, dos trabajos. La plaza es Places y el roster. La persona que todavia no es CLIENT es Leads, REGISTERED o WAITING LIST.
steps: Places (Booking Portal) es la oferta: plazas libres y plazas cogidas. Service roster es quien ya esta reservado y el instructor de siempre. New client mete a una persona en una plaza libre. Edit term slot cambia esa plaza para el resto del term.
Leads es un padre o una madre que pidio un codigo OTP. Lee Outcome: solo miro, empezo el formulario, se registro, ya era cliente, o lista de espera.
REGISTERED termino el formulario y nunca ha tenido plaza. Servicio y hora van vacios. Pay hold, Hold y Lost slot son chips en esa lista.
WAITING LIST es alguien que se registro y el servicio que quiere esta lleno. Esta esperando una plaza. No es Leads y no es REGISTERED.
Quien ya tiene plaza es CLIENT. Esa lista esta en Clients & Families, Active. No esta en estas tres listas.
tips: El camino es Leads, luego REGISTERED, luego WAITING LIST si el servicio esta lleno, y New client cuando hay un hueco en Places. Despues sale en Service roster como CLIENT.

lessons.title: Places (Booking Portal)
lessons.summary: This screen is the offer families can book. Each row is one time band: who is already in it, and how many seats are still open.
steps: This page is not Service roster. Places is the Booking Portal offer. Service roster is a different screen: who is booked and the standing instructor.
Refresh reloads the live seats from the roster. Open Booking Portal opens the family site in a new tab, so you see the same offer they see. Waiting list opens the WAITING LIST screen.

Day, Service and Venue filter the board. All days, All services and All venues show the whole offer. Open places only hides bands that are already full. Turn that box off when you also need to see full bands.

Open bands is how many bands in this filter still have at least one free seat. Free slots is how many empty seats those bands add up to. Full bands is how many bands are full, and those rows only show when Open places only is off. Total rows is how many bands the filter is showing. None of those numbers is a count of people to call.
Each weekday is its own block, for example Monday, 11 bands. One row is one band: service, venue, time, the seat list, and Place.
In Slots, each name is a taken seat. Open plus a number means free seats in that band. Full means there is no free seat. A line such as 2/2 means both seats are taken.

Place existing puts someone who is already REGISTERED, on the WAITING LIST, or already a CLIENT into that open seat. Place new starts a new client on that open seat. Those two buttons only appear when the band still has a free seat.
New client, in the Services & places menu, is the same job as Place new: a person who is not on a place yet, taking an open seat from this screen.

Aquatic on the Booking Portal is always 30 minutes. A family may book two halves in a row with the same instructor. This screen keeps the halves as two rows, so one half can be offered or filled without the other.
Intensive Courses and Camps sit under the weekday blocks. They are the July crash weeks. They are not the weekly Autumn days.
Who sits in a band for the rest of term is Edit term slot. One date only is Schedule & Covers. The Instructor timetable is staff hours, not this offer.
When a family pays a finish-booking or trial link, that child should appear on Sessions Overview on the first session date. You do not type that into LOCAL.
Leads, REGISTERED and WAITING LIST are the people before they are CLIENT. They are the next menu items. They are not extra filters on this board.
tips: Do not read Open bands, Free slots or Total rows as families to phone.
Parents do not see an instructor day off on the Booking Portal.
Pay hold, Hold and Lost slot are chips on REGISTERED. They are not columns on this board.
A cancelled place is not an open seat until Edit term slot or the release has cleared the child.

es.title: Places (Booking Portal)
es.summary: Esta pantalla es la oferta que las familias pueden reservar. Cada fila es una franja: quien ya esta dentro y cuantas plazas siguen libres.
steps: Esta pagina no es Service roster. Places es la oferta del Booking Portal. Service roster es otra pantalla: quien esta reservado y el instructor de siempre.
Refresh vuelve a cargar las plazas vivas. Open Booking Portal abre la web de familias en otra pestana, para ver la misma oferta que ven ellos. Waiting list abre la pantalla WAITING LIST.

Day, Service y Venue filtran el tablero. All days, All services y All venues ensenan toda la oferta. Open places only esconde las franjas que ya estan llenas. Quitale la marca si tambien quieres ver las llenas.

Open bands es cuantas franjas de este filtro siguen con al menos una plaza libre. Free slots es cuantas plazas vacias suman esas franjas. Full bands es cuantas franjas estan llenas, y solo se ven si quitas Open places only. Total rows es cuantas franjas ensena el filtro. Ninguno de esos numeros es gente a la que llamar.
Cada dia es un bloque, por ejemplo Monday, 11 bands. Una fila es una franja: servicio, sede, hora, la lista de plazas, y Place.
En Slots, cada nombre es una plaza ocupada. Open y un numero son plazas libres en esa franja. Full quiere decir que no queda plaza. Una linea como 2/2 quiere decir que las dos plazas estan cogidas.

Place existing mete en esa plaza libre a alguien que ya es REGISTERED, esta en WAITING LIST, o ya es CLIENT. Place new empieza un cliente nuevo en esa plaza libre. Esos dos botones solo salen si la franja todavia tiene un hueco.
New client, en el menu Services & places, es el mismo trabajo que Place new: una persona que todavia no tiene plaza y coge un hueco de esta pantalla.

Aquatic en el Booking Portal es siempre 30 minutos. Una familia puede coger dos medias seguidas con el mismo instructor. Esta pantalla las deja en dos filas, para poder ofrecer o llenar una mitad sin tocar la otra.
Intensive Courses and Camps va debajo de los dias de la semana. Son las semanas crash de julio. No son los dias semanales de Autumn.
Quien se sienta el resto del term se cambia en Edit term slot. Un solo dia es Schedule & Covers. El Instructor timetable son las horas del personal, no esta oferta.
Cuando una familia paga el enlace de finish-booking o de trial, ese nino tiene que salir en Sessions Overview el dia de la primera sesion. Eso no se escribe en LOCAL.
Leads, REGISTERED y WAITING LIST son las personas antes de ser CLIENT. Son las siguientes pantallas del menu. No son filtros de este tablero.
tips: No leas Open bands, Free slots ni Total rows como familias a las que llamar.
Los padres no ven el dia libre de un instructor en el Booking Portal.
Pay hold, Hold y Lost slot son chips en REGISTERED. No son columnas de este tablero.
Una plaza cancelada no es un hueco hasta que Edit term slot o la baja hayan quitado al nino.

lessons.title: Service roster
lessons.summary: Who is booked on the standing seat, and which instructor holds that band. This is not the Booking Portal offer.
steps: Service roster is its own screen. The Places day, service and venue filter does not belong here.
Open the filter: Weekday, Class, Venue, Instructor, Participant. Any day, Any class, Any venue, Any instructor and Any participant show the whole standing board.
Refresh reloads the roster. Space available keeps bands that still have a free seat. Participants on waiting list keeps rows that have someone waiting for that band.
A row is the standing booking: the child, the time, the venue and the instructor. Two aquatic halves on the same day stay as two rows here, so one half can change without the other.
To change who is booked, or the instructor, for the rest of term, use Edit term slot. The anchor date must be the same weekday as the service.
To change one date only, use Schedule & Covers. That does not rewrite the standing roster.
New client and Place new live on Places (Booking Portal), because a new person takes an open seat from the offer.
CLIENT names on this roster are people on a place now. REGISTERED, LEADS, WAITING and OLD are not standing booked rows.
tips: Instructor hours for the week are the Instructor timetable under H&R, not this roster.
A cancelled standing place becomes No participant and can show as open on Places.

es.title: Service roster
es.summary: Quien esta reservado en la plaza de siempre, y que instructor lleva esa franja. No es la oferta del Booking Portal.
steps: Service roster es su propia pantalla. El filtro de dia, servicio y sede de Places no va aqui.
Abre el filtro: Weekday, Class, Venue, Instructor, Participant. Any day, Any class, Any venue, Any instructor y Any participant ensenan todo el roster.
Refresh vuelve a cargar el roster. Space available deja las franjas que aun tienen plaza libre. Participants on waiting list deja las filas con alguien esperando esa franja.
Una fila es la reserva fija: el nino, la hora, la sede y el instructor. Dos medias de aquatic el mismo dia siguen siendo dos filas, para poder cambiar una mitad sin la otra.
Para cambiar quien esta reservado, o el instructor, el resto del term, usa Edit term slot. La fecha ancla tiene que ser el mismo dia de la semana que el servicio.
Para cambiar un solo dia, usa Schedule & Covers. Eso no reescribe el roster fijo.
New client y Place new estan en Places (Booking Portal), porque una persona nueva coge un hueco de la oferta.
Los nombres CLIENT de este roster son gente que tiene plaza ahora. REGISTERED, LEADS, WAITING y OLD no son filas reservadas.
tips: Las horas del instructor en la semana son el Instructor timetable en H&R, no este roster.
Una plaza fija cancelada pasa a No participant y puede salir como hueco en Places.

lessons.title: Finish-booking / trial paid → Overview
lessons.summary: When a family pays finish-booking, the trial seat appears on the day board without editing LOCAL.
lessons.where: Booking / pay link → then Sessions Overview
steps: Family completes finish-booking payment (Stripe or bank confirm).
Ops sync folds MADRE + trial schedule_overrides (+ dated roster row).
Open Sessions Overview on the first session date — the child should appear.
If missing, check payment status and Schedule & Covers / overrides for that date.
After the trial ends, the parent is sent a term finish link for the same place. They have until the end of that day. No reply releases the place.
tips: Do not put suitability wording on pay links.
Aquatic: one override per 30-minute half, not one 60-minute band.
The term link is automatic. Reply FREE releases the place. A different slot is a reply to the office, not a new trial.

es.title: Finish-booking / trial pagado y Overview
es.summary: Cuando una familia paga finish-booking, la plaza de trial sale en el tablero del dia sin tocar LOCAL.
es.where: Enlace de pago y luego Sessions Overview
steps: La familia paga finish-booking (Stripe o confirmacion de banco).
El sistema pliega MADRE, el override de trial y la fila del roster de ese dia.
Abre Sessions Overview en la fecha de la primera sesion. El nino tiene que salir.
Si no sale, mira el pago y Schedule & Covers / overrides de ese dia.
Cuando acaba el trial, al padre le llega un enlace de term para la misma plaza. Tienen hasta el final de ese dia. Si no contestan, la plaza se suelta.
tips: En los enlaces de pago no pongas frases de suitability.
Aquatic: un override por cada media hora, no una banda de 60 minutos.
El enlace de term sale solo. Contestar FREE suelta la plaza. Otra hora es una respuesta a la oficina, no un trial nuevo.

lessons.title: Edit term slot (standing clients)
lessons.summary: Change who is booked for the rest of term (or that weekday pattern). This is clients/places — not staff hours.
lessons.where: Services & places → Edit term slot (or from Timetable name → Edit term slot)
steps: Open Edit term slot for the venue, weekday and time band.
Change the participant, open seat, or pool / area as needed.
Choose scope: rest of term / matching weekdays — not a one-day-only exception.
The anchor date sets the weekday. To cancel Sundays, the anchor must be a Sunday. A Wednesday anchor cancels Wednesdays.
Rest of term from the anchor drops that date and later matching weekdays. Dates before the anchor stay.
Set the time slot before save. Clicking the Now card picks the seat; it does not change the anchor date.
Save — Services, Overview and parent term chips update from the live roster.
tips: One day only → Schedule & Covers.
Every [weekday] until end of term also drops days already delivered. Use Rest of term from the anchor when those past days should stay.
Staff who-works hours → Timetable (H&R), not Edit term slot.
To seat a worker with a Day Centre child for the rest of term: open that weekday and time, set the instructor, scope Rest of term from the anchor. The anchor must be that weekday.
Example: Joel → Anas every Monday for the rest of Autumn = Edit term slot.
To remove the service for the rest of term, use the Cancel a service lesson.

One date only, two children who already have seats: Schedule and Covers, Swap with another child today. They exchange every seat that day. Instructors stay. Edit term slot is only when that order should stay for the rest of term. Gabriel and Cyrus from Sun 27 Sep is that standing Sunday order.

es.title: Edit term slot (clientes fijos)
es.summary: Cambia quien esta reservado el resto del term (o ese dia de la semana). Es clientes y plazas, no las horas del personal.
es.where: Services & places → Edit term slot (o desde el nombre en Timetable → Edit term slot)
steps: Abre Edit term slot para la sede, el dia de la semana y la franja.
Cambia el participante, la plaza libre, o la piscina / zona.
El alcance es el resto del term o los mismos dias de la semana. No es una excepcion de un solo dia.
La fecha ancla marca el dia de la semana. Para cancelar domingos, el ancla tiene que ser un domingo. Un ancla en miercoles cancela miercoles.
Rest of term from the anchor quita ese dia y los mismos dias de la semana que vienen despues. Los dias anteriores al ancla se quedan.
Pon la franja de hora antes de guardar. Pulsar la tarjeta Now elige la plaza. No cambia la fecha ancla.
Guarda. Services, Overview y los chips del padre se actualizan con el roster vivo.
tips: Un solo dia es Schedule & Covers.
Every [weekday] until end of term tambien quita dias que ya se dieron. Usa Rest of term from the anchor cuando esos dias pasados tienen que quedarse.
Las horas de quien trabaja son Timetable (H&R), no Edit term slot.
Para sentar a un trabajador con un nino de Day Centre el resto del term: abre ese dia y esa hora, pon el instructor, alcance Rest of term from the anchor. El ancla tiene que ser ese dia de la semana.
Ejemplo: Joel a Anas todos los lunes el resto de Autumn = Edit term slot.
Para quitar el servicio el resto del term, usa la leccion Cancel a service.

Un solo dia, dos ninos que ya tienen plaza: Schedule and Covers, Swap with another child today. Cambian todas las plazas de ese dia. Los instructores se quedan. Edit term slot es solo si ese orden tiene que quedarse el resto del term. Gabriel y Cyrus desde el domingo 27 Sep es ese orden fijo de los domingos.

lessons.title: Cancel a service (rest of term)
lessons.summary: Remove a standing place from an anchor date forward. The anchor date decides which weekday is cancelled.
steps: Open Edit term slot on that client's seat.
Action: Cancel service.
Scope: Rest of term (from anchor) when days already delivered should stay.
Set the anchor to a date that is the same weekday as the service. A Sunday place needs a Sunday anchor. A Wednesday anchor cancels Wednesdays.
Set the time slot, then save. Clicking the Now card only picks the seat. It does not change the anchor.

That anchor date and later matching weekdays drop. Dates before the anchor stay. The seat stays on the board as No participant and opens on the public offer. The instructor gets one roster alert for the first cancelled day.

Parents see a cancelled chip for those dates. Rest of term and Every weekday open a sheet with the refund (paid, sessions already done, 10% administration, amount back, and what will not be collected). Confirm sends one message to the parent. The bank transfer is still paid back the same way. LA / NHS do not get the administration charge.
tips: Every [weekday] until end of term also removes days already delivered. Use that only when the whole weekday pattern should go, including the past.
One session only: Schedule & Covers, not Edit term slot.
Private pay-in-advance: 10% of the unused amount, minimum £25, maximum £100. Delivered sessions and a summer crash course stay paid. LA / NHS do not use this fee.
Parents do not cancel the standing service from the parent hub. A one-day absence is Absents / Refunds and credits. The whole service is admin, Edit term slot, Cancel service.

A finished service cancellation with money returned is its own Finance list, beside Absents. Absents stays one session: credit, refund, makeup, or none. The service list is the place gone and the unused money paid back.

es.title: Cancelar un servicio (resto del term)
es.summary: Quita una plaza fija desde una fecha ancla hacia delante. El ancla decide que dia de la semana se cancela.
steps: Abre Edit term slot en la plaza de ese cliente.
Accion: Cancel service.
Alcance: Rest of term (from anchor) cuando los dias ya dados tienen que quedarse.
Pon el ancla en una fecha que sea el mismo dia de la semana que el servicio. Una plaza de domingo necesita un ancla en domingo. Un ancla en miercoles cancela miercoles.
Pon la franja y guarda. Pulsar la tarjeta Now solo elige la plaza. No cambia el ancla.

Ese dia ancla y los mismos dias de la semana posteriores se caen. Los dias anteriores se quedan. La plaza sigue en el tablero como No participant y se abre en la oferta publica. El instructor recibe un aviso de roster por el primer dia cancelado.

Los padres ven un chip cancelado en esas fechas. Rest of term y Every weekday abren una hoja con el reembolso (pagado, sesiones ya dadas, 10% de administracion, lo que se devuelve y lo que no se va a cobrar). Confirm manda un mensaje al padre. La transferencia se devuelve igual. LA / NHS no llevan ese cargo de administracion.
tips: Every [weekday] until end of term tambien quita dias ya dados. Usalo solo cuando todo ese dia de la semana tiene que irse, incluido el pasado.
Una sola sesion: Schedule & Covers, no Edit term slot.
Pago privado por adelantado: 10% de lo no usado, minimo 25 libras, maximo 100. Las sesiones ya dadas y un crash de verano siguen pagados. LA / NHS no usan esta tasa.
Los padres no cancelan el servicio fijo desde su portal. Una falta de un dia es Absents / Refunds and credits. El servicio entero es admin, Edit term slot, Cancel service.

Una cancelacion de servicio ya cerrada, con el dinero devuelto, es una lista propia en Finance, al lado de Absents. Absents sigue siendo una sesion: credit, refund, makeup o none. La lista de servicio es la plaza que se fue y el dinero no usado que se devolvio.

categories.title: Clients & Families
categories.blurb: CLIENT list, family messages and family documents.

lessons.title: Participant buckets
lessons.summary: Office language: CLIENT, REGISTERED, LEADS, WAITING, OLD — use only these labels.
steps: CLIENT — on services now (Autumn seats).
REGISTERED — finished registration, never been a seated client.
LEADS — OTP / enquiry, registration not finished.
WAITING — want a full service; on the wait list.
OLD — were clients but no slots from September 2026 (e.g. unpaid Aug release).
tips: Do not say former / alumni in office chat — say OLD.
Kareena counted through Sun 28 Sep 2026. From Tue 29 Sep 2026 she is OLD.

es.title: Cubos de participantes
es.summary: Lenguaje de oficina: CLIENT, REGISTERED, LEADS, WAITING, OLD. Usa solo estas etiquetas.
es.where: Cubos de personas en el menu / filtros de CLIENT
steps: CLIENT: tiene servicio ahora (plazas de Autumn).
REGISTERED: termino el registro y nunca ha tenido plaza.
LEADS: pidio OTP o pregunto, y no termino el registro.
WAITING: quiere un servicio que esta lleno; esta en lista de espera.
OLD: fueron clientes pero no tienen plaza desde septiembre 2026 (por ejemplo la baja impagada de agosto).
tips: En la oficina no digas former ni alumni. Di OLD.
Kareena conto hasta el domingo 28 Sep 2026. Desde el martes 29 Sep 2026 es OLD.

lessons.title: What you do with the people on Leads
lessons.summary: Leads are people who asked for an OTP code. Outcome says what they did next.
steps: The page opens on Portal OTP only. Each row is a parent who asked for a code.

Outcome is the result of that lead. Only looked means they used the code and did not register. Registered means they finished the form. Already a client, only looked means they already had a place and came back. Already a client, registered again means they sent a new registration. Asked for a code means the code is not used yet.
Filter Outcome to see one of those results. OTP leads is how many rows that filter is showing.
Track status is optional. Leave New. You do not work through those rows. Booked takes that email off the marketing list. It does not change Outcome.

Filter first with Search, Origin, Track status and Outcome. Write to this filter sits under those filters. Tick a row only when you want to write to that parent. Send via Family broadcast, or Copy emails / Copy phones.
Email interest is an old office file. Open it from Origin only when you want a marketing send.
Add / update potential client is only for a parent you type in by hand. Save potential does not give them a place.
tips: Visits to the Booking Portal are not on this page. A visit is not a lead.

es.title: Que hacer con la gente de Leads
es.summary: Leads son personas que pidieron un codigo OTP. Outcome dice que hicieron despues.
steps: La pagina abre solo en Portal OTP. Cada fila es un padre o una madre que pidio un codigo.

Outcome es el resultado de ese lead. Only looked: uso el codigo y no se registro. Registered: termino el formulario. Already a client, only looked: ya tenia plaza y volvio. Already a client, registered again: mando un registro nuevo. Asked for a code: el codigo todavia no se ha usado.
Filtra Outcome para ver uno de esos resultados. OTP leads es cuantas filas ensena ese filtro.
Track status es opcional. Dejalo en New. No tienes que pasar fila por fila. Booked saca ese email de la lista de marketing. No cambia Outcome.

Filtra primero con Search, Origin, Track status y Outcome. Write to this filter va debajo de esos filtros. Marca una fila solo cuando quieras escribir a ese padre. Send via Family broadcast, o Copy emails / Copy phones.
Email interest es un archivo viejo de oficina. Abrelo en Origin solo cuando quieras un envio de marketing.
Add / update potential client es solo para un padre que escribes a mano. Save potential no le da una plaza.
tips: Las visitas al Booking Portal no estan en esta pagina. Una visita no es un lead.

lessons.title: What Leads is
lessons.summary: A lead is a parent who asked for an OTP code. Outcome is what happened next.
steps: This page is not the child list. A row is a parent who asked for a code.
Outcome Only looked: they used the code and did not finish the form.
Outcome Registered: they finished the registration form and have no place yet.
Outcome Already a client, only looked: they already have a child in class and came back without a new form.
Outcome Already a client, registered again: they already have a child here and sent a new registration.
Email interest is an old office file under Origin. It is not the lead list.
tips: REGISTERED, under Services & places, is the child who finished the form and has no place. That is a different screen.

es.title: Que es Leads
es.summary: Un lead es un padre o una madre que pidio un codigo OTP. Outcome es lo que paso despues.
steps: Esta pagina no es la lista de ninos. Una fila es un padre que pidio un codigo.
Outcome Only looked: uso el codigo y no termino el formulario.
Outcome Registered: termino el formulario de registro y todavia no tiene plaza.
Outcome Already a client, only looked: ya tiene un nino en clase y volvio sin un formulario nuevo.
Outcome Already a client, registered again: ya tiene un nino aqui y mando un registro nuevo.
Email interest es un archivo viejo de oficina, dentro de Origin. No es la lista de leads.
tips: REGISTERED, en Services & places, es el nino que termino el formulario y no tiene plaza. Es otra pantalla.

lessons.title: What each block on Leads does
lessons.summary: The page opens on OTP leads. Outcome filters the table. The count is those rows.
steps: Add / update potential client is a form. You type a parent by hand: name, email, phone, activity, track status, and a note. Email is required. Save potential stores that parent.

Track status is optional. Leave it on New. Booked takes that email off the marketing list. Following up, Waiting, Not booking and Closed are only if you want your own mark. It does not change Outcome.
OTP leads is the number of rows in the current filter. It is people, not visits.
Write to this filter sits under the filters. It is not a filter. The line says how many you ticked, how many viewed a service, and how many are already a client.

Select all shown ticks every row in the current filter. Select viewed services ticks people who opened a service. Select existing clients ticks parents who already have a child here. Clear unticks. None of these book a place.

Search looks at name, email, phone, and the enquiry note. Origin stays on Portal OTP only. The other origins are the old email file and people the office typed in. Outcome narrows the table. Refresh reloads it.
Each table row is one parent. Outcome says what they did after the code. Open PDF opens a form when one is linked. The date is the last activity.
tips: Leave Origin on Portal OTP only. Email interest is only for a marketing send.

es.title: Que hace cada bloque de Leads
es.summary: La pagina abre en OTP leads. Outcome filtra la tabla. El numero son esas filas.
steps: Add / update potential client es un formulario. Escribes a mano nombre, email, telefono, actividad, track status y una nota. El email es obligatorio. Save potential guarda a ese padre.
Track status es opcional. Dejalo en New. Booked saca ese email de la lista de marketing. Following up, Waiting, Not booking y Closed son solo si quieres tu propia marca. No cambia Outcome.
OTP leads es el numero de filas del filtro actual. Son personas, no visitas.
Write to this filter va debajo de los filtros. No es un filtro. La linea dice cuantos marcaste, cuantos vieron un servicio y cuantos ya son cliente.

Select all shown marca todas las filas del filtro. Select viewed services marca quien abrio un servicio. Select existing clients marca padres que ya tienen un nino aqui. Clear quita las marcas. Nada de esto reserva una plaza.

Search mira nombre, email, telefono y la nota. Origin se queda en Portal OTP only. Los otros origenes son el archivo viejo de emails y la gente que escribio la oficina. Outcome estrecha la tabla. Refresh la recarga.
Cada fila es un padre. Outcome dice que hizo despues del codigo. Open PDF abre un formulario cuando hay uno enlazado. La fecha es la ultima actividad.

lessons.title: How to email or WhatsApp people on Leads
lessons.summary: Filter first, then tick rows and send. That writes to the parent. It does not reserve a place.
lessons.where: Services & places → Leads → Write to this filter
steps: Use Search, Origin, Track status and Outcome first, so the table is the group you want. Write to this filter is under those filters.
Tick the rows, or use Select all shown, Select viewed services, or Select existing clients.
Copy emails puts the ticked addresses on the clipboard. Copy phones does the same for numbers.
Send via Family broadcast opens the family message with those people already chosen.
Sending a message does not book a place and does not move the child to REGISTERED or ACTIVE.
tips: Family broadcast lives under Clients & Families → Family. Leads only chooses who receives it.

es.title: Como escribir por email o WhatsApp a gente de Leads
es.summary: Filtra primero, luego marca filas y envia. Eso escribe al padre. No reserva una plaza.
es.where: Services & places → Leads → Write to this filter
steps: Usa Search, Origin, Track status y Outcome primero, para que la tabla sea el grupo que quieres. Write to this filter va debajo de esos filtros.
Marca las filas, o usa Select all shown, Select viewed services o Select existing clients.
Copy emails copia los emails marcados. Copy phones hace lo mismo con los telefonos.
Send via Family broadcast abre el mensaje a familias con esa gente ya elegida.
Enviar un mensaje no reserva una plaza y no mueve al nino a REGISTERED ni a ACTIVE.
tips: Family broadcast esta en Clients & Families → Family. Leads solo elige quien lo recibe.

lessons.title: How to add a parent who never opened the portal
lessons.summary: Use Add / update potential client. They join the outreach list unless you mark them Booked.
lessons.where: Services & places → Leads → Add / update potential client
steps: Type the parent name, email, and phone. Email is required.
Activity is a note such as Aquatic Wed. Enquiry / notes is whatever they asked.
Leave track status as New unless you already know they will not book, or they are Booked.
Save potential. The row appears in the table.
To see only people the office typed in, set Origin to Office potential clients.
tips: Booked takes them off the automatic marketing list. Every other track status keeps them on it.

es.title: Como anadir un padre que nunca abrio el portal
es.summary: Usa Add / update potential client. Entra en la lista de contacto salvo que lo marques Booked.
es.where: Services & places → Leads → Add / update potential client
steps: Escribe nombre del padre, email y telefono. El email es obligatorio.
Activity es una nota, por ejemplo Aquatic Wed. Enquiry / notes es lo que preguntaron.
Deja track status en New salvo que ya sepas que no van a reservar, o que estan Booked.
Save potential. La fila sale en la tabla.
Para ver solo gente que escribio la oficina, pon Origin en Office potential clients.
tips: Booked les saca de la lista automatica de marketing. Cualquier otro track status les deja dentro.

lessons.title: What Leads is not
lessons.summary: Hold, lost slot, REGISTERED, and CFK LEADS are other screens.
steps: REGISTERED is Services & places → REGISTERED. That child finished the registration form and has no place now. Service and Time slot stay empty. The date is the day they registered.

On that REGISTERED list, Booking status stays REGISTERED. The Place filter next to it chooses All, Pay hold, Hold or Lost slot. Pay hold means the seat is still held for payment. Hold is an office hold. Lost slot means the hold ended or the place was released. The chip sits under the name.
Someone who already has a place stays ACTIVE. They do not get the Pay hold, Hold, or Lost slot chip.
CFK LEADS is a filter on the contacts table. It is the old Class for Kids file. It is not this Leads page.
Lost slot on Finance is a family who re-enrolled and did not pay. That chip is on the invoice, not on Leads.
tips: The i on each page is the manual for that screen. Leads does not book a seat.

es.title: Lo que Leads no es
es.summary: Hold, lost slot, REGISTERED y CFK LEADS son otras pantallas.
steps: REGISTERED es Services & places → REGISTERED. Ese nino termino el formulario y no tiene plaza ahora. Service y Time slot van vacios. La fecha es el dia en que se registro.

En esa lista REGISTERED, Booking status se queda en REGISTERED. El filtro Place, al lado, elige All, Pay hold, Hold o Lost slot. Pay hold: la plaza sigue retenida para el pago. Hold: retencion de oficina. Lost slot: la retencion acabo o la plaza se solto. El chip va bajo el nombre.
Quien ya tiene plaza se queda ACTIVE. No lleva el chip Pay hold, Hold ni Lost slot.
CFK LEADS es un filtro de la tabla de contactos. Es el archivo viejo de Class for Kids. No es esta pagina de Leads.
Lost slot en Finance es una familia que rehizo la inscripcion y no pago. Ese chip esta en la factura, no en Leads.
tips: La i de cada pagina es el manual de esa pantalla. Leads no reserva una plaza.

lessons.title: Leads and REGISTERED
lessons.summary: Leads is who asked for an OTP code. REGISTERED is a child who finished the form and has no place.
lessons.where: Services & places → Leads, and Services & places → REGISTERED
steps: Leads is not a second child list. It is parents who asked for an OTP code. The page opens on those people.
OTP leads counts those parents. It is not visits. Email interest is an old file under Origin, only for a marketing send.
Add potential, Select all, Copy emails and Send via Family broadcast are for writing to those parents. They do not book a place.
Outcome Already a client means that parent already has a child in class. Already a client, registered again means they sent a new form.
REGISTERED is the contacts table. The child finished the form and has no place now. Service and Time slot stay empty. The date is the day they registered.

On REGISTERED, Booking status stays REGISTERED. The Place filter next to it chooses Pay hold, Hold or Lost slot. Pay hold means the seat is still held for payment. Hold is an office hold. Lost slot means the hold ended or the place was released. The chip sits under the name. Someone who already has a place stays ACTIVE and does not get that chip.
CFK LEADS is a filter on the contacts table, the old Class for Kids file. It is not the Leads page.
tips: Lost slot on Finance is a family who re-enrolled and did not pay. That chip is on the invoice, not on this Leads page.

es.title: Leads y REGISTERED
es.summary: Leads es quien pidio un codigo OTP. REGISTERED es un nino que termino el formulario y no tiene plaza.
es.where: Services & places → Leads, y Services & places → REGISTERED
steps: Leads no es una segunda lista de ninos. Son padres que pidieron un codigo OTP. La pagina abre con esa gente.
OTP leads cuenta esos padres. No son visitas. Email interest es un archivo viejo dentro de Origin, solo para un envio de marketing.
Add potential, Select all, Copy emails y Send via Family broadcast sirven para escribir a esos padres. No reservan una plaza.
Outcome Already a client quiere decir que ese padre ya tiene un nino en clase. Already a client, registered again quiere decir que mando un formulario nuevo.
REGISTERED es la tabla de contactos. El nino termino el formulario y no tiene plaza ahora. Service y Time slot van vacios. La fecha es el dia en que se registro.

En REGISTERED, Booking status se queda en REGISTERED. El filtro Place, al lado, elige Pay hold, Hold o Lost slot. Pay hold: la plaza sigue retenida para el pago. Hold: retencion de oficina. Lost slot: la retencion acabo o la plaza se solto. El chip va bajo el nombre. Quien ya tiene plaza se queda ACTIVE y no lleva ese chip.
CFK LEADS es un filtro de la tabla de contactos, el archivo viejo de Class for Kids. No es la pagina Leads.
tips: Lost slot en Finance es una familia que rehizo la inscripcion y no pago. Ese chip esta en la factura, no en esta pagina de Leads.

lessons.title: CLIENT list and profiles
lessons.summary: ACTIVE, WAITING, OLD CLIENTS, REGISTERED and CFK LEADS are separate filters. A person on WAITING does not also show under REGISTERED.
steps: Clients & Families in the left menu opens a screen with the same buttons. Under Clients: Active (the old CLIENT list), Progress and Reports. WAITING LIST and REGISTERED are under Services & places, next to Places and Leads. REGISTERED is the same contacts table as Active, filtered to people who finished the form and have never had a place. Registration Form under Documents is every Booking Portal form, including people already in class. That page is not LEADS. Under Family: Achievement photos, Family broadcast, Portal PINs (Family), Dashboard Teleport (Family). WhatsApp, family messages (P), staff messages (S), Comms (C) and Announcements (A) are the buttons in the top bar. The title is on the left. Back sits on the right.
The circle with i next to a page title opens what that page is for, plus the matching Office help steps. That text stays off the page.
ACTIVE: on a place now. A cancelled place is not ACTIVE. ACTIVE stays under the name, with the date of birth.
Support is the ratio, such as 1:1. Funding and Payment are separate columns. Funding is only one of three: Using Private funds (VAT 20%), Using LA funds (Exempt), or LA/NHS funded.

Payment can be more than one. The payment names are Bank Transfer (One off-Manually), Bank Transfer (Flexi-Manually), Apple Pay/Stripe, GoCardless, BACS (Ealing), Monthly Arrears (NHS), Monthly Arrears (NHS/ILA), Monthly Arrears (H&F), and Payment Link. Payment Link is an invoice marked payment link that is paid or part-paid. A Stripe checkout on that link stays Payment Link. An unpaid link does not count. When Bookings and Payments has two funders for the same child, both chips show. Ealing is BACS (Ealing). NHS/ILA, including a Friday paid by them, is Monthly Arrears (NHS/ILA).
Filter Funding and Payment on the CLIENT page. A payment filter keeps anyone who has that method, even if they also have another.

Funding and Payment come from the invoice. VAT 20% means the family pays (Using Private funds). No VAT and the family pays means Using LA funds (Exempt). No VAT and the office bills the council or NHS means LA/NHS funded. Summer is used when that is the invoice on file. Each funding type and each payment method has its own colour.
OLD CLIENTS were in summer 2026, or had a September service, and are not here now. Set Funding to All funding to see the whole list.

Someone who was never in summer is not OLD CLIENTS. A registration in September with no service stays REGISTERED. A Class for Kids waiting request with no booking stays old waiting list. A Class for Kids booking from September 2025 through August 2026 is OLD CLIENTS. The Class for Kids file with no booking in that window, and no waiting request, stays under CFK LEADS.

WAITING LIST under Services & places is this same table. Booking status stays WAITING LIST. The Waiting list filter next to it chooses All, Portal (Booking Portal from 12 Aug 2026), or Before the portal (CFK and the workbook from before that). Someone who already has a service is off Before the portal and stays ACTIVE. Source shows Booking Portal or Workbook. Funding and Payment are hidden. Newest join is at the top. A child who already has a service can also be on the Portal waiting list for another place. OTP with no finished registration stays in LEADS, not on these lists.

REGISTERED: filled the registration form, no term place, not on a waiting list. The Registered column is the day they registered, newest at the top. Someone who only comes to crash courses stays here, with Service set to Crash courses, so you can offer them a term place.

CFK LEADS: the Class for Kids contact file. Funding and Payment stay hidden. Age comes from the date of birth on that file. Service says Class for Kids. The time column is the first and last booking date from that file, when the file has them. The line under the status says Class for Kids file.

On Trial / Trialled: someone who booked a trial and has a trial session. Booked is the day they booked. Service and Time slot are that trial, not the place they have now. Trial session is only the day, plus On Trial or Trialled. A session still ahead is On Trial. A session already held is Trialled. Newest session is at the top. They stay ACTIVE as well when they took a term place afterwards.
Search finds a name even when Booking status is another list. The line under the filters says which list that person is on.

A short name on the bookings shows on that child's row when it is the same person. Consecutive halves on the same day show as one time. The venue is in brackets after the time, such as Tuesday, 3:30 pm to 5:00 pm (SWIMFARM).
Age uses the date of birth. If the contact has no date, the list uses the birth line on the registration (Clients Info).
Contact, email, phone and age come from the child's contact record. A short roster name still shows that parent and those details.
A group label such as a Day Centre block is not an extra client when the children in that group are already on the list. Tuesday ACAT 11-12 shows as Aquatic Activity on each member, at SwimFarm.
Direct Payments sit under Using LA funds (Exempt). The family pays. LA/NHS funded means the office bills the authority.

The Photo column is that child's own picture. A picture the parent uploaded or replaced in the portal is the one that shows. Until then, the office picture shows when we have one. If neither side has a picture, the initials show.
Do not put WAITING, REGISTERED, CFK LEADS or OLD CLIENTS on Sessions as booked kids.
tips: A shared first name does not share a photo. Each row keeps that child's own face.

The Registered column is the registration date on the contact. If that date is empty, it is the day the child was added in the portal. Date of birth is not that day. If neither date is on file, the cell says Not on file.
A one-word name on the bookings is one child. Another child with that first name does not take the place.

es.title: Lista CLIENT y fichas
es.summary: ACTIVE, WAITING, OLD CLIENTS, REGISTERED y CFK LEADS son filtros distintos. Alguien en WAITING no sale tambien en REGISTERED.
steps: Clients & Families abre Active, Progress y Reports. WAITING LIST y REGISTERED estan en Services & places, al lado de Places y Leads. REGISTERED es la misma tabla de contactos que Active, filtrada a quien termino el formulario y nunca ha tenido plaza. Registration Form, en Documents, es cada formulario del Booking Portal, tambien gente que ya esta en clase. Esa pagina no es LEADS. En Family estan Achievement photos, Family broadcast, Portal PINs (Family) y Dashboard Teleport (Family). WhatsApp, P, S, C y A son los botones de la barra. El titulo va a la izquierda. Back va a la derecha.
La i al lado del titulo abre para que sirve la pagina y los pasos de Office help. Ese texto no se queda en la pagina.
ACTIVE: tiene plaza ahora. Una plaza cancelada no es ACTIVE. ACTIVE va bajo el nombre, con la fecha de nacimiento.
Support es el ratio, por ejemplo 1:1. Funding y Payment son columnas distintas. Funding es solo una de tres: Using Private funds (VAT 20%), Using LA funds (Exempt), o LA/NHS funded.

Payment puede ser mas de uno. Los nombres son Bank Transfer (One off-Manually), Bank Transfer (Flexi-Manually), Apple Pay/Stripe, GoCardless, BACS (Ealing), Monthly Arrears (NHS), Monthly Arrears (NHS/ILA), Monthly Arrears (H&F) y Payment Link. Payment Link es una factura marcada payment link que esta pagada o pagada en parte. Un checkout de Stripe en ese enlace sigue siendo Payment Link. Un enlace sin pagar no cuenta. Si Bookings and Payments tiene dos pagadores para el mismo nino, salen los dos chips. Ealing es BACS (Ealing). NHS/ILA, incluido un viernes pagado por ellos, es Monthly Arrears (NHS/ILA).
Filtra Funding y Payment en la pagina CLIENT. Un filtro de pago deja a quien tiene ese metodo, aunque tenga otro tambien.

Funding y Payment salen de la factura. VAT 20% quiere decir que paga la familia (Using Private funds). Sin VAT y paga la familia quiere decir Using LA funds (Exempt). Sin VAT y la oficina factura al council o al NHS quiere decir LA/NHS funded. Summer se usa cuando esa es la factura que hay. Cada tipo de funding y cada metodo de pago tiene su color.
OLD CLIENTS estuvieron en verano 2026, o tuvieron un servicio en septiembre, y ahora no estan. Pon Funding en All funding para ver la lista entera.

Quien nunca estuvo en verano no es OLD CLIENTS. Un registro de septiembre sin servicio se queda REGISTERED. Una peticion de espera de Class for Kids sin reserva se queda en old waiting list. Una reserva de Class for Kids de septiembre 2025 a agosto 2026 es OLD CLIENTS. El archivo de Class for Kids sin reserva en esa ventana, y sin peticion de espera, se queda en CFK LEADS.

WAITING LIST en Services & places es esta misma tabla. Booking status se queda en WAITING LIST. El filtro Waiting list, al lado, elige All, Portal (Booking Portal desde el 12 Aug 2026), o Before the portal (CFK y el workbook de antes). Quien ya tiene un servicio sale de Before the portal y se queda ACTIVE. Source dice Booking Portal o Workbook. Funding y Payment van ocultos. El alta mas reciente va arriba. Un nino que ya tiene un servicio puede estar tambien en la lista Portal para otra plaza. OTP sin registro terminado se queda en LEADS, no en estas listas.

REGISTERED: relleno el formulario, no tiene plaza de term, y no esta en lista de espera. La columna Registered es el dia en que se registro, el mas reciente arriba. Quien solo viene a crash courses se queda aqui, con Service en Crash courses, para poder ofrecerle una plaza de term.

CFK LEADS: el archivo de contactos de Class for Kids. Funding y Payment van ocultos. La edad sale de la fecha de nacimiento de ese archivo. Service dice Class for Kids. La columna de hora es la primera y la ultima fecha de reserva de ese archivo, cuando el archivo las tiene. La linea bajo el estado dice Class for Kids file.

On Trial / Trialled: alguien que reservo un trial y tiene una sesion de trial. Booked es el dia en que reservo. Service y Time slot son ese trial, no la plaza que tiene ahora. Trial session es solo el dia, mas On Trial o Trialled. Una sesion que todavia no ha llegado es On Trial. Una sesion ya dada es Trialled. La sesion mas reciente va arriba. Siguen ACTIVE tambien si despues cogieron una plaza de term.
Search encuentra un nombre aunque Booking status sea otra lista. La linea bajo los filtros dice en que lista esta esa persona.

Un nombre corto de las reservas sale en la fila de ese nino cuando es la misma persona. Dos medias seguidas el mismo dia se ven como una hora. La sede va entre parentesis despues de la hora, por ejemplo Tuesday, 3:30 pm to 5:00 pm (SWIMFARM).
La edad usa la fecha de nacimiento. Si el contacto no tiene fecha, la lista usa la linea de nacimiento del registro (Clients Info).
Contacto, email, telefono y edad salen del registro de contacto del nino. Un nombre corto del roster sigue ensenando a ese padre y esos datos.

Una etiqueta de grupo, como un bloque de Day Centre, no es un cliente extra cuando los ninos de ese grupo ya estan en la lista. El martes ACAT 11-12 sale como Aquatic Activity en cada miembro, en SwimFarm.
Direct Payments va bajo Using LA funds (Exempt). Paga la familia. LA/NHS funded quiere decir que la oficina factura a la autoridad.

La columna Photo es la foto de ese nino. La foto que el padre subio o cambio en el portal es la que se ve. Hasta entonces se ve la foto de oficina, si la hay. Si no hay foto de ninguno de los dos lados, salen las iniciales.
No pongas WAITING, REGISTERED, CFK LEADS ni OLD CLIENTS en Sessions como ninos reservados.
tips: Un nombre de pila compartido no comparte foto. Cada fila guarda la cara de ese nino.

La columna Registered es la fecha de registro del contacto. Si esa fecha esta vacia, es el dia en que se anadio el nino en el portal. La fecha de nacimiento no es ese dia. Si no hay ninguna de las dos, la celda dice Not on file.
Un nombre de una sola palabra en las reservas es un nino. Otro nino con ese nombre de pila no se queda la plaza.

lessons.title: Participant photo missing on the parent hub
lessons.summary: Initials and No photo on file mean nothing is stored yet. The hub does not invent a picture.
lessons.where: Parent hub, under the child circle
steps: Open the parent hub for that child.
If the circle shows initials and No photo on file, there is no saved photo on the participant.
The parent presses Add photo under the circle and chooses a picture.
Refresh the hub. The photo then shows for the family and for staff.
tips: A child added without a registration photo stays on initials until someone adds one.
Staff only see the photo after it is saved. A picture on a phone or in email does not appear by itself.

lessons.title: One waiting list, then Portal or before
lessons.summary: Booking status stays WAITING LIST. The Waiting list filter splits Portal from Before the portal.
steps: Open Services & places → WAITING LIST. Booking status stays WAITING LIST. It is the same table as Active.
The Waiting list filter next to Booking status chooses All, Portal (from 12 Aug 2026), or Before the portal (CFK and the workbook from before that day).
Portal and Before the portal are that filter, not extra rows in Booking status. It is the same table.
Source is Booking Portal or Workbook. It is the same split as the WAITING page.
The list is newest join at the top and oldest at the bottom. Not on file sits at the bottom.
Funding and Payment are hidden. They fill in on ACTIVE when the child has a service.
A child who already has a service can also be on portal waiting list for another place.
old waiting list drops anyone who already has a service. They stay on ACTIVE.
OTP with no finished registration stays in LEADS. Do not add a separate OTP-only filter on this list.
When a place opens (Services / Edit term slot / finish-booking), move them through your usual offer flow.
tips: Keep both waiting lists separate from LEADS and REGISTERED.

es.title: Una lista de espera, luego Portal o antes
es.summary: Booking status se queda en WAITING LIST. El filtro Waiting list separa Portal de Before the portal.
steps: Abre Services & places → WAITING LIST. Booking status se queda en WAITING LIST. Es la misma tabla que Active.
El filtro Waiting list, al lado de Booking status, elige All, Portal (desde el 12 Aug 2026), o Before the portal (CFK y el workbook de antes de ese dia).
Portal y Before the portal van en ese filtro, no como filas extra de Booking status. Es la misma tabla.
Source es Booking Portal o Workbook. Es el mismo corte que la pagina WAITING.
La lista pone arriba quien se apunto mas reciente y abajo el mas antiguo. Not on file se queda abajo.
Funding y Payment van ocultos. Se rellenan en ACTIVE cuando el nino tiene un servicio.
Un nino que ya tiene un servicio puede estar tambien en portal waiting list para otra plaza.
old waiting list quita a quien ya tiene un servicio. Esos se quedan en ACTIVE.
OTP sin registro terminado se queda en LEADS. No anadas un filtro solo de OTP en esta lista.
Cuando se abre una plaza (Services / Edit term slot / finish-booking), pasalos por el camino de oferta de siempre.
tips: Deja las dos listas de espera separadas de LEADS y de REGISTERED.

lessons.title: What parents see vs office
lessons.summary: Parent hub chips and Team names vs office-only chrome.
steps: Parents see term chips: cancelled, absent, cover name when a real cover is assigned.
Parents do not see instructor day off / COVER NEEDED / Cover TBC.
Office uses Overview + Schedule & Covers for the full picture.
If a parent asks why a cover shows, check instructor_reassign has a real cover name.

categories.title: Finance
categories.blurb: Invoices, payments, Direct Payment mandate, refunds, credits and make-ups.

lessons.title: Help a parent authorise Direct Payment (GoCardless)
lessons.summary: Phone script for families who still need to authorise the bank mandate. Office cannot do this for them.
lessons.where: Parent portal → child / invoices → Set up Direct Payment (not admin Finance)

demos.caption: What the parent sees: blinking red Set up Direct Payment on the invoice card.
Office: ask Who has not authorised Direct Payment? for the live list.

steps: Ask them to open the Parent portal: https://www.clubsensational.org/parent and sign in (PIN / email on file).
Open the child / invoices / payment area for that family.
Find the blinking red button: Set up Direct Payment.
They tap it — GoCardless opens so they can authorise Direct Debit with their bank.
They complete bank authorisation (app / online banking as GoCardless asks).
Back in the parent portal it should show Direct Payment set up (mandate active). Later invoices collect on due dates.
tips: Office cannot authorise the mandate for them — the payer must finish GoCardless.
If they do not see the button: refresh; confirm the path is Direct Payment (GoCardless), not bank transfer / Flexi only; office can resend parent portal access / PIN.
Use this when they already chose Direct Payment but never finished bank authorisation.

lessons.title: Create and share an invoice
lessons.summary: Build a family invoice in Portal Finance and send the pay / view link.

demos.caption: Finance area — create invoice is the first card path.

steps: Open Finance.
Create the invoice for the family / term lines you need.
Share the link (WhatsApp / email) using the portal send tools.
Track status until paid or followed up.
tips: Keep finish-booking copy free of suitability wording.

es.title: Crear y compartir una factura
es.summary: Monta una factura de familia en Finance y manda el enlace de pago o de ver.
steps: Abre Create invoice. El titulo de la pantalla es Create invoice, no Finance.
Busca el contacto, elige al participante, el modo de VAT, el importe, la cantidad y el vencimiento.
Los campos de LA salen cuando el modo es LA / NHS. Mid-term y la subida del PDF van cerrados hasta que los abras.
Comparte el enlace por WhatsApp o email con las herramientas del portal.
Sigue el estado hasta que este pagada o hasta el siguiente aviso.
tips: En el texto del enlace de finish-booking no pongas frases de suitability.
Create invoice y Xero products no son los tres botones de la fila de Finance. Esos tres son Re-enrolments, Payments y Absents.

lessons.title: Validate / mark paid
lessons.summary: Confirm payment so the family and ops state match.
steps: Open the invoice or payment row.
Confirm bank / Stripe payment as your process requires.
Mark paid / validate so re-enrol and booking status update.
If a finish-booking trial was waiting, check Overview for the first session date.

es.title: Validar / marcar pagado
es.summary: Confirma el pago para que la familia y la oficina coincidan.
steps: Abre la fila de la factura o del pago.
Confirma el pago de banco o de Stripe segun el camino.
Mark paid / valida para que re-enrolment y el estado de la reserva se actualicen.
Si un trial de finish-booking estaba esperando, mira Overview en la fecha de la primera sesion.
Despues de una transferencia, el padre tiene que avisar a la oficina. Un toque en el enlace no marca el pago solo.
tips: Payment Link es una factura marcada como payment link que esta pagada o pagada en parte. Un enlace sin pagar no cuenta.

lessons.title: Absents, refunds and credits
lessons.summary: Decide missed sessions: no action, credit, refund path, or close.
steps: One day with no instructor: Schedule and Covers, that date, Change on the child's card, then Cancelled. Do not use Absent. Absent is the family missing the session.
In Reason write that there is no instructor and ask the parent to reply refund or credit. Save. That day only is cancelled. The standing service stays.
The parent gets a WhatsApp that the session is cancelled, including that note. The row lands in Absents, refunds and credits.

When the parent replies, open that row. Choose Credit or Refund, then Approve. For a refund enter the session amount. For a credit enter the same amount, or leave the amount blank for a session credit with no cash figure.
Approve writes the family ledger and sends the outcome message. Makeup is only if they ask for another day.
tips: Sep+ absents and cancellations share one decide queue.
The automatic cancel WhatsApp does not choose refund or credit. Put the question in Reason so the parent can reply.

Private pay-in-advance cancellation: unused prepaid can be refunded with a fee of 10% of the unused amount (minimum £25, maximum £100). Sessions already delivered, including a summer crash course, stay paid. LA / NHS do not use this fee.
Cancelling the standing place is Edit term slot. Set the anchor to a date on that weekday, then Rest of term from the anchor.

es.title: Faltas, reembolsos y creditos
es.summary: Decide las sesiones perdidas: nada, credito, camino de reembolso, o cerrar.
steps: Un dia sin instructor: Schedule & Covers, esa fecha, Change en la tarjeta del nino, y luego Cancelled. No uses Absent. Absent es la familia que falta a la sesion.
En Reason escribe que no hay instructor y pide al padre que conteste refund o credit. Guarda. Solo ese dia se cancela. El servicio fijo se queda.
El padre recibe un WhatsApp de que la sesion esta cancelada, con esa nota. La fila cae en Absents, refunds and credits.

Cuando el padre contesta, abre esa fila. Elige Credit o Refund, y luego Approve. En un refund pon el importe de la sesion. En un credit pon el mismo importe, o dejalo en blanco para un credito de sesion sin cifra.
Approve escribe el libro de la familia y manda el mensaje del resultado. Makeup solo si piden otro dia.
tips: Las faltas y cancelaciones de septiembre en adelante comparten una sola cola de decision.
El WhatsApp automatico de cancelacion no elige refund ni credit. Pon la pregunta en Reason para que el padre pueda contestar.

Cancelacion de pago privado por adelantado: lo no usado se puede devolver con una tasa del 10% de lo no usado (minimo 25 libras, maximo 100). Las sesiones ya dadas, incluido un crash de verano, siguen pagadas. LA / NHS no usan esta tasa.
Cancelar la plaza fija es Edit term slot. Pon el ancla en una fecha de ese dia de la semana, y luego Rest of term from the anchor.
